SYSTEM:
You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION A:
Jermaine Jackson
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0125 | jermaine.jackson@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Reporting analyst at a credit union with about $2.4B in assets, three years into the role after starting in loan operations. Writes SQL and builds SSRS reports for compliance, lending and the leadership team, and has begun automating small tasks in Python. Strongest at accurate, repeatable reporting on regulatory deadlines, and comfortable handling data requests from auditors and examiners.

EXPERIENCE
Reporting Analyst | Harborstone Federal Credit Union, Columbus, OH | Nov 2023 to Present
• Build and maintain 35 SSRS reports on loan originations, delinquency, deposit balances and member growth, delivered on fixed schedules to lending, finance and the executive team.
• Write SQL Server queries for HMDA and quarterly call report data pulls, reconciling totals to the general ledger before each submission.
• Handle 10 to 15 ad hoc requests a month from branch and lending managers, such as auto loan volume by dealer or certificate maturities by month.
• Wrote a Python script with pandas that formats the monthly delinquency extract for the board packet, saving about three hours a month.
• Found and corrected a join in a legacy report that double counted members with joint accounts and had overstated active membership by 4 percent.
• Started a Power BI proof of concept for branch managers covering new accounts and loan referrals; it is now in use at four of 17 branches.
• Built a monthly branch scorecard in Excel covering new memberships, loan applications and deposit growth, emailed to branch managers on the third business day.
• Served as the reporting contact on the core banking system conversion, rewriting 12 reports against the new table structure and comparing outputs line by line for two months.
• Document report logic and data sources in a shared wiki so other staff can answer routine questions.

Loan Operations Specialist | Harborstone Federal Credit Union, Columbus, OH | Jul 2021 to Oct 2023
• Processed auto and personal loan documents and checked data entry in the loan origination system, about 40 files a week.
• Kept Excel trackers of funding times and document exceptions for the loan operations supervisor.
• Helped the reporting team clean up loan purpose codes on 6,000 records, which led to the move into reporting.
• Answered member and dealer questions about funding status by phone and email.
• Pulled samples for quarterly loan file audits and checked documents against the review checklist.
• Covered the member contact center during peak months, answering loan payment and payoff questions.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2021

SKILLS
SQL: SQL Server (joins, CTEs, aggregate queries, some window functions), stored procedures for report datasets
Reporting: SSRS, Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, conditional formatting), early Power BI work
Programming: Python (pandas basics, scheduled scripts)
Domain: consumer lending, deposit reporting, HMDA, NCUA call report, member data
Tools: Visual Studio report projects, SharePoint, Jira for request tracking

ADDITIONAL
• Completed an online Power BI fundamentals course, 2025
• Member of a local SQL Server user group
• Volunteer at a free tax preparation site each spring, handling intake and data entry
